item.title: Can't Pathshala: Bangla PowerPoint Party — Fri Nov 20, 7:00 PM — Ruposhi Bangla Restaurant
item.description:
Address: Ruposhi Bangla Restaurant Toronto, ON Canada
Can't Pathshala is in session: A Bangla PowerPoint Party with the most random presentations, most unhinged takes and the most delicious snacks. Bangladeshi culture isn't the most mainstream or popular as a concept. We often get confused with Indians (average pet peeve of a Bangali) and we'd like to change that, tastefully, through humor and community. So, please come learn about the random country that's the second largest exporter of clothes and has the longest beach in the world but you may not know much about. Did we mention, you get to try Bangladeshi snacks? Yeah, there's gonna be food.…
Hosted by The Can't Social
Source: Luma Toronto Discover

item.title: 2026 Mulan International Film Festival — Sat Nov 21, 7:00 PM — Innis Town Hall
item.description:
From November 21 to December 3, join the 7th Mulan International Film Festival at Toronto’s Innis Town Hall. As the largest film festival dedicated to Chinese-language cinema in North America, Mulan brings restored classics and new voices to the big screen.
Opening night presents the Canadian premiere of the 4K restoration of Patrick TAM’s Love Massacre, starring Brigitte LIN. The festival closes with the North American premiere of CHONG Keat Aun’s Golden Horse Award-winning Mother Bhumi, winner of Best Leading Actress for FAN Bingbing, Best Cinematography and Best Original Film Song.
Discover six features and nine shorts from emerging filmmakers in the Fountainhead competition programme, and vote for your favourites. Other highlights include the world premiere of the new 4K restoration of Clara LAW’s Farewell, China, starring Maggie CHEUNG and Tony LEUNG Ka-Fai, and On Canvas, On Stage, a complete retrospective of QIU Jiongjiong’s films, including A New Old Play and Madame.

item.title: Listening Club: A Music Social for Seniors — Mon Nov 23, 1:00 PM — Malvern
item.description:
Join us for 4 weeks of fun afternoons where participants can connect over shared musical experiences while enjoying some light refreshments. Music Share for Seniors staff will play your favourite songs while you share the memories they inspire. Or sit back, listen and enjoy the musical experiences of those around you. Get ready to jam out while connecting with new friends! Music Share for Seniors is an organization dedicated to reducing senior social isolation through personalized music-based programs and meaningful social interaction. This program is geared towards older adults and seniors. Register in advance or drop-in on the day. Participants are encouraged to join every week and connect with others! Mondays, November 23, 30, December 7, 14 1 – 2:30pm

item.title: Exit Points #78 — Fri Nov 27, 7:30 PM — Arraymusic
item.description:
Exit Points is a live music series that invites you into the world of musical improvisation, even if it’s your first time. Each event begins with simple listening strategies to help you feel more at ease with unfamiliar sounds and forms. You’ll then hear two short sets by small ensembles of expert musicians from a range of musical backgrounds, each exploring spontaneous and unscripted ways of making music together. The night ends with “Switchemups”: a fun, low-pressure session where audience members are welcome to join the musicians on stage and try improvising themselves (totally optional!). Expect an evening of surprising sounds, creative energy, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
Source: Toronto Events (Tockify)

EXPLORE THE BEHIND-THE-SCENES OF ARTISTS’ CREATIVE PROCESSES
Ever wondered what goes on behind the studio doors? Now’s your chance to find out!
Please join us for an afternoon of creativity, curiosity, and a little artistic chaos at Flick the Switch’s Open Studio at The Grange! Meet around 30 talented artists working across an exciting mix of mediums, from stained glass to painting to fabric art, installations, and everything in between. Get a peek into their creative processes, discover works in progress, explore unique artistic spaces, and see firsthand what happens when imagination takes over.

item.title: YUMYUM: November — Sat Nov 28, 10:00 PM — Complex19
item.description:
YumYum is your home to move, explore, and connect. At its heart, this is a dance party—designed for queers to lose themselves in the music, the space, and their own desires. While we're proudly sex-positive, this is not exclusively a play party. It’s a space where consent is everything, and you’re free to express yourself however feels right—whether that means dancing all night, lounging with friends, or embracing moments of intimacy. From 10 PM to 7 AM, our multi-room, multi-floor venue transforms into an hazy playground of sound, movement, and possibility. No expectations, no pressure, no cameras—just the freedom to be unapologetically you. ‍
Source: YOHOMO
